Elective courses Students must get 18 credits (CFU/ECTS) by choosing two courses from the following list.

Further elective courses Students must get 9 CFU/ECTS by choosing one or more courses offered by the University of Milan. The course of choice has to award a final mark. Please check https://mhr.cdl.unimi.it/en/courses/9-credit-courses. Moreover, students must get 3 CFU by choosing from internship, workshops, assessment of advanced computer skills, assessment of advanced knowledge foreign languages, traineeship abroad. Please check https://mhr.cdl.unimi.it/en/courses/3-credit-activities.

Students who do not have an Italian qualification can choose to obtain 3 CFU in Additional language skills: Italian (for more details see the section Language test / computer literacy test) Additional Language Skills: Italian (3 ECTS) Advanced Language Skills: French (3 ECTS) Advanced Language Skills: German (3 ECTS Advanced Language Skills: Spanish (3 ECTS)
